title: 朝阳眼镜蛇pro一年使用感受
notes: Owner post (edited 2026-04-13): a Falcon ('Cobra Pro') rear lasted about a year and just under 10,000 km with one sidewall cut, then developed a deep crack exposing the puncture layer; the bike's original Maxxis Pursuer had fewer cracks after similar use. Commenters: another Falcon owner had one flat and no nail punctures; one said a CNY 70 CST C1808 lasted 15,000 km; one said an ARISUN tire cracked within a year.
